tasks.label: Verify video inspection packaging
args: $app = Get-Item 'dist\app\ffprobe.exe' -ErrorAction Stop; $installer = Get-Item 'dist\Image Metadata Cleaner Setup.exe' -ErrorAction Stop; Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem; $zip = [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead('installer\appbundle.zip'); try { $entry = $zip.Entries | Where-Object { $_.FullName -ieq 'ffprobe.exe' } | Select-Object -First 1; [pscustomobject]@{ AppFfprobe=$app.FullName; AppFfprobeBytes=$app.Length; Installer=$installer.FullName; InstallerBytes=$installer.Length; BundleFfprobe=if($entry){$entry.FullName}else{'MISSING'}; BundleFfprobeBytes=if($entry){$entry.Length}else{0} } | Format-List } finally { $zip.Dispose() }

tasks.label: Verify packaged ffprobe file
args: Get-Item "dist/app/ffprobe.exe" | Select-Object FullName,Length | Format-List; Get-Item "dist/Image Metadata Cleaner Setup.exe" | Select-Object FullName,Length | Format-List

tasks.label: Verify installer bundle ffprobe
args: Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem; $zip = [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead("installer/appbundle.zip"); try { $zip.Entries | Where-Object { $_.FullName -ieq "ffprobe.exe" } | Select-Object FullName,Length | Format-List } finally { $zip.Dispose() }

tasks.label: Verify video error messaging
args: Select-String -Path "desktop/Program.cs" -Pattern "The video inspection failed","Status = \"Skipped\"","Inspection failed" | Select-Object LineNumber,Line | Format-Table -AutoSize

tasks.label: Verify video error messaging retry
args: Select-String -Path "desktop/Program.cs" -Pattern "The video inspection failed" | Select-Object LineNumber,Line; Select-String -Path "desktop/Program.cs" -Pattern "Inspection failed" | Select-Object LineNumber,Line; Select-String -Path "desktop/Program.cs" -Pattern "Status =" | Select-Object LineNumber,Line

tasks.label: Verify FFprobe build guards
args: Select-String -Path "build-package.ps1" -Pattern "ffprobe.exe","does not contain ffprobe","could not be copied" | Select-Object LineNumber,Line
